notable_absence.finding: The #api (REST) procedure section on this page has no separate prerequisite of its own beyond the page-level 'Search Admin' role stated once at the top - unlike this batch's other REST/UI pairs, where each surface has its own independent Prerequisites section. Because this is one page rather than two, the role requirement is stated exactly once for both procedures, not duplicated.

cross_component_finding: The #ui procedure builds the autocomplete index out of five separate, cross-referenced sub-tasks in sequence (Create a Custom Analyzer x2, Create a custom token filter, Create a Type Mapping, optionally Create a Child Mapping, Create a Child Field) plus manual selection of the resulting custom analyzer as the field's analyzer and the index's Default Analyzer. The #api procedure achieves the identical index definition (same `edge_ngram` analyzer, same `edge_ngram_2_8` token filter with min/max 2/8, same field-level analyzer assignment) in a single JSON payload passed to [Create a Search Index with the REST API and curl/HTTP](create-search-index-rest-api.md) - the page states 'You can use the generated index definition JSON payload from the UI to create a Search index with the REST API', explicitly confirming the two procedures produce the same artifact even though the UI path chains five sub-task pages the REST path does not need to touch individually.
